scripts.dev:clean: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$port = if ($env:PORT) { [int]$env:PORT } else { 5000 }; $connections = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $port -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($connections) { $connections | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_ -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host ('Killed PID ' + $_ + ' on port ' + $port) } } else { Write-Host ('Port ' + $port + ' is free') }; npm run dev"
